# ProtocolSoup Documentation

> Docs for the live ProtocolSoup sandbox. This host serves documentation only. The protocols, the JSON API, and the MCP server run on https://protocolsoup.com; the wallet runs on https://wallet.protocolsoup.com.

None of the endpoints below needs authentication.

## Explore the protocol catalog

- To list the protocols ProtocolSoup implements, `GET https://protocolsoup.com/api/protocols`, or call the MCP tool `list_protocols` with `POST https://protocolsoup.com/mcp`.
- To list the flows a protocol defines, `GET https://protocolsoup.com/api/protocols/{protocolId}/flows`, or call the MCP tool `list_protocol_flows`.
- To read the ordered steps of one flow, call the MCP tool `describe_protocol_flow` with `protocolId` and `flowId`.

## Decode a token

- To decode a JWT and check its signature against the sandbox key set, call the MCP tool `decode_jwt` with `POST https://protocolsoup.com/mcp`, or `POST https://protocolsoup.com/api/lookingglass/decode` with the JSON body `{"token": "<compact JWT>"}`.

## Call the MCP server

- To find the MCP servers, `GET https://protocolsoup.com/.well-known/ai-catalog.json`.
- To read the Server Card, `GET https://protocolsoup.com/mcp/server-card`.
- To call a tool, `POST https://protocolsoup.com/mcp` with the headers and `_meta` shown in [Calling a tool](https://docs.protocolsoup.com/protocols/mcp/).

## Read discovery metadata

- To read the OpenID Connect discovery document, `GET https://protocolsoup.com/.well-known/openid-configuration`.
- To fetch the OpenID Provider signing keys, `GET https://protocolsoup.com/oidc/.well-known/jwks.json`.
- To read OAuth 2.0 Authorization Server metadata, `GET https://protocolsoup.com/.well-known/oauth-authorization-server` or `GET https://protocolsoup.com/.well-known/oauth-authorization-server/oauth2`.
- To read the OID4VCI Credential Issuer metadata, `GET https://protocolsoup.com/.well-known/openid-credential-issuer/oid4vci`, and its signing keys, `GET https://protocolsoup.com/oid4vci/.well-known/jwks.json`.
- To list the HTTP APIs, `GET https://protocolsoup.com/.well-known/api-catalog`.
- To list the agent skills and their `sha256` digests, `GET https://protocolsoup.com/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json`.

## Look up normative requirements

- To list the specifications in the conformance registry, `GET https://protocolsoup.com/api/conformance/specs`.
- To read one specification or requirement, `GET https://protocolsoup.com/api/conformance/specs/{specId}` or `GET https://protocolsoup.com/api/conformance/requirements/{requirementId}`.
- To read the passing and failing exchanges captured from production for one requirement, `GET https://protocolsoup.com/api/conformance/requirements/{requirementId}/artefacts`.

## Drive the wallet

- To issue, import, resolve, and present credentials, call `POST https://wallet.protocolsoup.com/api/issue`, `/api/import`, `/api/resolve`, and `/api/present` on the wallet origin, then `GET https://wallet.protocolsoup.com/api/session` to read the store.
- [Wallet request bodies](https://wallet.protocolsoup.com/llms-full.txt)
